subject: Numbers certification playbook for board – action items & evidence

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Numbers certification playbook for board – action items & evidence

Team —

We need a quick, auditable run to certify the ARR / bookings narrative for next week’s board packet. Attach is a lightweight playbook (spreadsheet + evidence checklist). Goal: close gaps and lock commitments by EOD Thu so Laura can fold into the board slides on Friday.

Top asks (please treat as checklist):
- Sales: for every Commit-stage opportunity marked for Q3, confirm stage + expected close date + any remaining gating docs (SOW, PO, legal). Update HS record and flag with tag: "board-cert".
- Finance ops: reconcile any itemized discounts or credits in the bookings column to contract exhibits; flag anything >$25k.
- CS: verify deployment start dates for recognized revenue triggers (proof: onboarding kickoff notes).

I've highlighted the 12 accounts I think are high-sensitivity in tab "Red Flags". If you can't reach a contact, note last contact and who owns outreach.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Wed 5pm PT: initial verification entries in the playbook (column G-H populated).
- Thu 12pm PT: second pass and dispute resolution (finance + legal if needed).
- Thu EOD: final decisions (Commit / Commit-Pending-Legal / At-Risk).

Attachments: 2026-08-18_playbook_numbers_certification.xlsx (master), board_evidence_template_v2.pdf (evidence checklist).

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Looping in a couple of notes from finance ops after a quick scan of the export:

1) Acme (HS:deal-0045912) — there is a $48,750 credit tied to a professional services adjustment that is not present in the Master Order Form. I need the SOW or amendment showing the discount or we should move this to Commit-Pending-Legal.

2) Iliad Health — onboarding scheduled but contracting still missing final signature. Sales note says E-sign expected 8/20. For the board, mark as At-Risk until signed.

3) Vertex Labs — revenue recognition should exclude a $12k MSP voucher; finance recommends we disclose this carve-out in the footnote paragraph.

I uploaded two supporting files to the drive folder: "finance_play_export_Aug18.csv" and a redlined discount summary. I also flagged deals where billing contact mismatch exists (that affects invoicing and therefore booking confirmation).

If Sales can get SOWs for Acme and the signature for Iliad by Thu noon PT I will re-evaluate. Otherwise we move Acme -> Commit-Pending-Legal; Iliad -> At-Risk.
